summary:
Implemented the next Garage staging slice.

Added **Save Run Note** to `garage.html#maintenance-note-preview` in both the one-visit Maintenance handoff receipt and the store-run summary. It saves a timestamped `Maintenance Staging Run` snapshot into existing Garage Notes, includes the current staging export, and explicitly preserves the boundary that Need/Staged toggles remain local-only outside Garage backup/sync.

Also updated search metadata, bumped the service worker to `ridgeline-console-v290`, extended browser smoke coverage, and updated Anton/state/backlog/roadmap/audit notes.

Verification passed:
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('garage.html')`
- `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
- `Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('maintenance.html','garage.html') -Tag audit-v290-staging-run-note -SkipScreenshots`

Screenshot helper still failed in this shell, so I used direct Playwright fallback:
- `debug-screenshots/audit-v290-staging-run-note-mobile-garage.png`
- `debug-screenshots/audit-v290-staging-run-note-desktop-garage.png`

Next safe slice: real iPhone review of the Stage receipt, Save Run Note wording, and Share Buy List behavior before adding larger inventory/job-template schema work.
